metadata.title: The role of Massive Black Holes in merging star clusters: dynamical evolution, stellar & compact object ejections and gravitational waves

notes: No eligible individual stars are included. The paper is an idealized N-body simulation of star-cluster mergers; its simulated escaping stars and compact objects are populations without individual stellar identifiers and are not assessed as present-day Galactic-unbound candidates. The only catalog-like stellar designation, J0731+3717 (T:p2-b2), is mentioned only as a previous discovery with an M15 origin, not as a target selected or analyzed here, and the text does not explicitly establish its present-day unbound status from the Milky Way. The broader HVS discussion is likewise contextual (T:p1-b8).
